$comment: Opaque overlays painted over time-dependent or brand regions before each shot, in CSS px of the viewport (not device px). A value is a number of CSS px or a percentage of the viewport width (x, w) / height (y, h); x may be 'center' to centre a box of width w. Optional filters restrict a mask to some screens, scales ('1.0'), viewports ('360x780'), themes or locales; a mask without a filter applies everywhere.

masks.reason: The SOS button pulses continuously (two expanding rings every 1.8 s); the ring area changes between shots.
